title: himantoglossum caprinum subsp. jankae
intro: Himantoglossum caprinum subsp. jankae, commonly known as Jankae's Orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant is a type of orchid, belonging to the genus Himantoglossum, and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Jankae's Orchid include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and hepatoprotective effects.
